 KUTV — Real Salt Lake's season finale is this weekend!
 Kyle Schroeder joined Fresh Living to share all about it. 
 Real Salt Lake needs a win in order to clinch a playoff spot, which makes this game especially important. 
 It is also their Fan Appreciation Match!
 RSL fans can celebrate with an in-app scavenger hunt, team store deals, and in-stadium giveaways. 
 Join the fun and cheer on Real Salt Lake this Saturday, November 7 at 5 p.m.
 For more information, visit RSL.com
